purpose: Freeze bounded identity/topology evidence from an IGP institutional-repository scientific article without promoting report figures, territorial coordinates, historical outcomes or descriptive hydraulic observations into geometry, routing, thresholds, controls, risk or alerts.

source.publication_venue: Revista del Instituto de Investigacion FIGMMG-UNMSM
source.title: Aspectos geologicos y geodinamicos de flujos aluvionales en la quebrada Jicamarca y analisis de la vulnerabilidad para la implementacion de un Sistema de Alerta Temprana (SAT) en el centro poblado Cajamarquilla
source.reproducibility_note: Stable repository item, handle and bitstream identifiers are frozen here. The binary was not ingested into the repository in this change; therefore no PDF hash is asserted. Claims below are bounded to explicit page/text locators and cannot promote spatial geometry.

jicamarca_parent_context.claim: The study describes a Jicamarca study basin/context containing distinct local subbasins or tributary systems named Huaycoloro, Rio Seco, El Silencio and Colca.
jicamarca_parent_context.source_locator: article page 49 / PDF page 2, section 1.1 Area de estudio

rio_seco_distinct_local_identity.claim: Rio Seco is named separately from Colca, El Silencio and Huaycoloro and was independently included in field mapping/geodynamic work.
rio_seco_distinct_local_identity.source_locator: article page 49 / PDF page 2, sections 1.1 and 2.1

local_scale_mapping_context.claim: The article reports local geological/geodynamic mapping at scale 1:10000 for the named ravine systems.

monitoring_context.claim: The article documents field monitoring equipment placed near the channels of Rio Seco and Huaycoloro.
monitoring_context.source_locator: article pages 54-55 / PDF pages 7-8, section 5.1.1 and conclusions

cajamarquilla_territorial_coordinate.claim: A UTM coordinate is reported for the Cajamarquilla population center.

bounded_historical_context.receiver_coupling_note: The article narrates a 1998 interaction involving sediment accumulation near Puente Huaycoloro and Rio Rimac water. This is retained only as documentary evidence that tributary-receiver interaction can matter; it is not a routing calibration, hydraulic capacity, exact confluence, travel time, attenuation or proof that every tributary activation causes receiver overflow.

geometry_gate.next_safe_gate: Acquire independently reproducible official or deterministic terrain/topology geometry for each local child and resolve exact outlet/confluence under frozen parameters; fail closed on ambiguity.
